name: Q#
summary: Q# is Microsoft's language for expressing quantum programs in the Quantum Development Kit, including qubit operations and classical control logic.
lifecycleNote: Microsoft QDK implementation released v1.33.0 on 2026-10-06.

name: R
summary: R is a language and environment for statistical computation and graphics, providing data analysis, modelling and extensible plotting facilities with links to native-code libraries.
lifecycleNote: The R project announced the R 4.6.1 release on 24 June 2026.

name: Racket
summary: Racket is a Lisp-family language and platform for language-oriented programming, with macros and tools for creating domain-specific languages and applications.
lifecycleNote: Racket implementation released v9.3 on 2026-08-13.

name: Raku
summary: Raku combines functional, object-oriented and other programming styles with grammars, gradual typing and facilities for scripting and concurrent programs.
lifecycleNote: Rakudo implementation released 2026.09 on 2026-09-28.

name: ReScript
summary: ReScript is a statically typed language that compiles to JavaScript, with JavaScript interoperability and tools for browser, Node.js and React applications.
lifecycleNote: ReScript implementation released v12.3.1 on 2026-08-24.

name: Reason
summary: Reason provides alternative syntax and tooling for OCaml, retaining its type system and allowing native OCaml applications or JavaScript output through Melange.
lifecycleNote: Reason tooling implementation released 3.18.0 on 2026-06-23.

name: Red
summary: Red is a Rebol-inspired language and toolchain with built-in dialects for parsing, GUI layout and lower-level programming, combining interpreted and compiled code.
lifecycleNote: The Red toolchain's official repository explicitly describes its current development stage as alpha.

name: Ring
summary: Ring is a dynamic multi-paradigm language with support for embedded domain-specific syntax and libraries for console, graphical, web and mobile applications.
lifecycleNote: Ring implementation released v1.27 on 2026-05-28.

name: Roc
summary: Roc is a statically typed functional language that separates application code from platform code, using type inference and platform packages for host integration.

name: Ruby
summary: Ruby is a dynamic object-oriented language with blocks and metaprogramming, used for scripting, data processing and web applications with frameworks such as Rails.
lifecycleNote: The Ruby project released Ruby 4.0.7 on 2026-09-15.

name: Rust
summary: Rust is a compiled systems language whose ownership and borrowing rules govern memory use and sharing, with applications in services, command-line tools and embedded code.
lifecycleNote: The Rust Release Team announced Rust 1.99.0 on 2026-10-01.

name: SAS
summary: SAS programs combine DATA steps for managing data with procedures for analysis and reporting, and macros for generating and reusing program text.
lifecycleNote: SAS announced SAS 9.4M9 in June 2025 with Standard Support through July 2030.

name: Scala
summary: Scala combines object-oriented and functional programming with static types, pattern matching and metaprogramming, supporting applications that integrate with its host platforms and libraries.
lifecycleNote: The Scala 3 implementation published compiler version 3.10.0 on 12 October 2026.

name: Scheme
summary: Scheme is a Lisp-family language emphasising lexical scope, first-class procedures and a compact core, with several independently developed implementations.

name: Smalltalk
summary: Smalltalk organises computation as objects exchanging messages, with live environments such as Squeak that let developers inspect and change running programs.
lifecycleNote: The OpenSmalltalk VM used by Squeak and Cuis published release 202606270913 on 2026-06-27.

name: Solidity
summary: Solidity is a statically typed language for smart contracts targeting the Ethereum Virtual Machine, with inheritance, libraries and user-defined types for on-chain application logic.
lifecycleNote: The Solidity compiler implementation published version 0.8.37 on 10 September 2026.

name: Squirrel
summary: Squirrel is a dynamic object-oriented language designed for embedding in applications such as games, with classes, generators and cooperative coroutines.

name: Standard ML
summary: Standard ML is a functional language with type inference, algebraic data types and modules; its formal definition specifies both typing and execution semantics.
lifecycleNote: The SML/NJ implementation published development release 2026.2 on 2026-08-14.

name: Starlark
summary: Starlark is a Python-like embedded configuration language with deterministic evaluation, used for Bazel build definitions and application-specific extension logic.
lifecycleNote: Bazel, which embeds Starlark for build rules, released 9.3.0 on 2026-10-07.

name: SuperCollider
summary: SuperCollider's sclang language controls a separate real-time audio server, supporting algorithmic sound synthesis, composition and interactive musical systems.
lifecycleNote: SuperCollider implementation released Version-3.14.1 on 2025-11-24.

name: Swift
summary: Swift is a statically typed language with value types, generics and optionals, used for applications on Apple platforms and for services and tooling on other supported platforms.
lifecycleNote: The Swift implementation published its 6.4.0 release on 15 September 2026.

name: TLA
summary: TLA+ is a mathematical specification language for describing state transitions and checking models of software or hardware, especially concurrent and distributed systems.

name: Tcl
summary: Tcl is an extensible dynamic scripting language used for automation, networking and application integration; its companion Tk toolkit supplies graphical interfaces.
lifecycleNote: The Tcl/Tk project lists Tcl/Tk 9.1.0 released on 2026-09-29.

name: Terra
summary: Terra is a compiled low-level language embedded in Lua, allowing Lua programs to generate and specialise native code and embed domain-specific JIT compilers.
lifecycleNote: Terra implementation released release-1.2.2 on 2026-08-14.

name: TypeScript
summary: TypeScript adds static type annotations and checking to JavaScript, then emits JavaScript that runs in browsers and server runtimes.
lifecycleNote: TypeScript implementation released v7.0.2 on 2026-08-20.

name: V
summary: V is a compiled language with C interoperability and integrated tooling, supporting native applications, command-line programs and network services.
lifecycleNote: V implementation released 0.5.2 on 2026-07-12.

name: VBA
summary: Visual Basic for Applications is embedded in Microsoft Office applications, using their object models to automate documents, spreadsheets and other repeated tasks.

name: VBScript
summary: VBScript is Microsoft's Visual Basic-family scripting language used with Windows Script Host and legacy Windows applications; Microsoft is phasing out its Windows component.
lifecycleNote: Microsoft deprecated the Windows VBScript component in October 2023 and plans phased removal; existing installations can still run it.

name: VHDL
summary: VHDL describes hardware designs whose behaviour can be simulated and whose synthesizable portions can be translated into gate-level implementations.
lifecycleNote: GHDL implementation released v6.0.0 on 2026-03-07.

name: Vala
summary: Vala offers object-oriented syntax and native compilation with direct GObject and GTK support, allowing applications to use existing C libraries.
lifecycleNote: GNOME published the Vala compiler 0.56.19 source release on 2026-03-30.

name: Verilog
summary: Verilog is a hardware description language for modelling digital circuits, writing simulation testbenches and describing designs for logic synthesis.
lifecycleNote: Icarus Verilog implementation released v13_0 on 2026-03-02.

name: Visual Basic .NET
summary: Visual Basic .NET is a .NET language with a stable design, used for Windows Forms applications and libraries. Microsoft's strategy retains core library support and C# interoperability without expanding to new workloads.
lifecycleNote: Microsoft's current strategy retains .NET library support and Visual Studio investment for existing Visual Basic scenarios; the language design remains stable.

name: WebAssembly
summary: WebAssembly is a binary instruction format for a stack-based virtual machine, serving as a portable compilation target for programs deployed in host environments.

name: Wolfram Language
summary: Wolfram Language represents code and data as symbolic expressions and includes built-in computation and visualisation functions for technical and mathematical work.
lifecycleNote: The Mathematica implementation released version 15 in June 2026 and 15.0.1 with fixes in July 2026.

name: XQuery
summary: XQuery is a W3C query language for selecting and constructing XML data; XQuery 3.1 also adds maps, arrays and operations for working with JSON.

name: Xtend
summary: Xtend is a statically typed Java dialect that generates readable Java source, adding features such as lambdas, extension methods and compile-time macros.

name: Yacc
summary: Yacc uses grammar rules and associated actions to generate parsers, traditionally producing C source for recognising structured input such as programming-language syntax.

name: Yul
summary: Yul is Solidity's intermediate language for optimisation and EVM bytecode generation, and can also be written directly as Solidity inline assembly.
lifecycleNote: Solidity implementation released v0.8.37 on 2026-09-10.

name: Zeek
summary: Zeek's event-driven scripting language extends its network monitor, turning protocol events into custom analysis, logs and network-observation policies.
lifecycleNote: Zeek implementation released v9.0.0 on 2026-08-21.

name: Zig
summary: Zig is a general-purpose language and toolchain with explicit memory management and C interoperability, used for native applications and cross-platform builds.
lifecycleNote: The Zig project's release index dates compiler release 0.17.0 to 2026-10-01.
